title: Choose the visual world
question: The assigned direction is a Blue-Hour Field Folio. Keep it, re-roll for another grounded direction, or take the plain portfolio route.

options.label: Blue-Hour Field Folio
options.thesis: A portfolio as an annotated record of a mind with many lines of inquiry.
options.viewport: The supplied collage leads as one large image plate; the introduction and working navigation sit in its margins, and the next section begins as a quiet field entry.
options.risk: The observatory language could make the site feel like an art project; plain labels and a clear contact route keep the portfolio legible.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional portfolio structure with restrained surfaces and expected navigation.
canonCard.viewport: A straightforward introduction followed by work, about, interests, and contact sections.
canonCard.risk: It has less of the image's distinctive personality.
